description: This file is a Makefile fragment for building host tools in the OpenWrt build system, defining build steps, variables, and include directives for host environment compilation.

methods.name: Host/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the source directory for host build, optionally unpacking and copying source files.

methods.name: Host/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the host build environment by running the configure script with specified variables and arguments.

methods.name: Host/Compile/Default
methods.description: Compiles the host build using make with specified jobs and variables.

methods.name: Host/Install/Default
methods.description: Installs the compiled host build into the specified prefix.
